items.titleZh: APEX创始人：其他运动不应盲目模仿F1
items.summaryZh: APEX创始人兼首席执行官安东尼奥·卡科里诺在一场活动上提出，其他运动可能过于专注追随F1的脚步，而忽视了发挥自身优势。

media.altZh: APEX创始人：其他运动不应盲目模仿F1 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Sports must ditch 'obsession' over F1's success
items.summaryEn: Antonio Cacorino, CEO and founder of APEX, suggested at an event that other sports may be too focused on following in Formula 1's footsteps rather than playing to their own strengths.
detailZh: F1的成功引发了一波追随者，其他运动试图复制F1在所有者自由媒体集团旗下所享有的那种人气飙升。
但这些运动是否过于专注追随F1的脚步，而忽视了发挥自身优势？
这正是APEX创始人兼首席执行官安东尼奥·卡科里诺在《F1高端玩法手册》活动上向达伦·考克斯和观众提出的假设；该活动由The Race与Axios主办。
APEX是一家专注体育的投资公司，获得包括F1车手兰多·诺里斯、卡洛斯·塞恩斯和瓦尔特利·博塔斯在内的100多名运动员支持。该公司还持有阿尔派 F1车队的少数股份。
卡科里诺表示，F1的增长归功于“多种不同因素共同作用的结果”，其中包括经常被提及的Netflix真人秀《极速求生》带来的效应。
“时机也相当重要，”他补充道。“人们没有意识到，Netflix恰好在全世界因新冠疫情停摆、所有人都被困在家中的时候（2020年初）推出了《极速求生》第二季。这也起到了助推作用。
“但在生活中，有时你也需要某些事情恰好契合。他们明白那对他们有利。然后显然，结果就摆在这里。”
自2019年首播以来，《极速求生》催生了一股纪录片热潮，高尔夫PGA巡回赛（《全力挥杆》）、职业网球（《破发点》）、公路自行车（《环法自行车赛：逆风飞驰》）和纳斯卡（《全速前进》）等纷纷效仿。然而，这些系列节目在向新观众展示这些运动方面有多成功，一直难以评判。
“我们已经看到Netflix推出的体育内容数量。显然，我们正处于内容过多的阶段，”卡科里诺说。
“所以，很难取得同样的成功。显然，F1凭借《Drive to Survive》做到了。但我确实认为，这类内容和这种媒体运作是许多大型体育项目需要做的。
“但只有在你达到一定地位之后才行。其他体育项目或许应该有这类策略，但也许可以作为一种吸引更多眼球的方式，然后通过赞助或其他替代方式变现。
“我不认为这应该成为一种执念，因为很难复制。现在有成千上万的体育项目在尝试这样做。”
F1在全球疫情期间及之后的增长，得益于其作为当时首批恢复比赛的体育项目之一的独特地位、《极速求生》效应，以及2021年刘易斯·汉密尔顿与马克斯·维斯塔潘之间的冠军争夺战，这些因素共同帮助它成为如今这样的庞然大物。
当在台上被问及他是否看到F1未来面临任何风险时，卡科里诺表示：“说实话，我看不到太多风险。我认为它规模太大，不会失败。”
“它确实已经达到了一个让车迷留下来的水平。我不认为有任何其他运动能挑战它。”
“显然，你可能会遇到监管规则变化，新的潜在所有者可能进来，或许会把它引向不同的方向。但我确实认为F1已经达到了一个会持续存在的位置。它是这个全球知识产权，品牌会想要进来。”
“车迷们始终会在这里关注并消费这项运动。总会有越来越多不同的车手和明星涌现出来。
“所以我认为风险很小，只是任何其他行业都会面临的普遍宏观（经济）风险。
“但我要说，不存在任何结构性风险。因此我抱有长期愿景，我今天就会投资，并长期作为投资者留下来。”
detailEn: Formula 1’s success has triggered a wave of aspirants as other sports try to match the same meteoric rise in popularity that F1 has enjoyed under owner Liberty Media.
But are those other sports too focused on following F1’s footsteps over playing to their own strengths?
That’s the hypothesis that Antonio Cacorino, CEO and founder of APEX, offered to Darren Cox and the audience at 'Formula One's Premium Playbook', an event hosted by The Race and Axios.
APEX is a sports-focused investment firm backed by more than 100 athletes including F1’s Lando Norris, Carlos Sainz, and Valtteri Bottas. It also owns a minority stake in the Alpine F1 team.
Cacorino said that F1’s growth is down to a “combination of different factors that all clicked together”, including the regularly cited effect of Netflix’s Drive to Survive reality series.

“Timings were also quite important," he added. "People don't realise the fact that Drive to Survive Season 2 was being pushed by Netflix exactly when the whole world stopped and everyone was stuck at home in COVID [in early 2020]. That also helped.
“But in life, sometimes you also need certain things to click. And they understood that was in their favour. And then obviously the result is here.”

Drive to Survive spawned a documentary race since it premiered in 2019, with the likes of golf's PGA Tour (Full Swing), professional tennis (Break Point), road cycling (Tour de France: Unchained) and NASCAR (Full Speed) following suit. Yet how successful those series were at exposing those sports to new audiences has been hard to judge.
“We already see the amount of sports content that Netflix is putting out. Obviously, we're at the stage where there's too much content,” said Cacorino.

“So, it's very hard to achieve the same success. Obviously, F1 did with Drive to Survive. But I do think it's that kind of content and that kind of media play is something that a lot of the big sports need to do.

“But only once you've achieved certain status. Other sports should maybe have those kinds of strategies, but maybe kind of as a way to bring a bit more eyeballs and then monetise through sponsorships or through other alternatives.
"I don't think that should be an obsession, because it's very hard to replicate. Now there's thousands of sports trying to do it.”

F1’s growth during and after the global pandemic, thanks to its unique position as one of the first sports to return to competition during that time, the Drive to Survive effect, and the 2021 championship fight between Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen, helped it become the juggernaut it is now.
Asked on stage if he sees any risks on the horizon for F1, Cacorino said: “To be honest, I don't see many risks. I think it's too big to fail.
“It's reached, really, a level where fans are here to stay. I don't think there's any other sport challenging.

“Obviously you can get regulatory changes, a new potential owner can come in and maybe take it in a different direction. But I do think that F1 has reached a position where it's here to stay. It's this global IP that brands will want to come in.
“Fans are always going to be here consuming the sport. There's always going to be more and more different drivers and stars coming up.
“So I think there's few risks, just general macro[economic] risks that any other sector can take.
“But I would say there's nothing structural that would call for a risk. Hence the long-term vision I have that I would invest today and stay as an investor for a long time.”
keyPointsZh: APEX是一家体育领域投资公司，背后有包括诺里斯、塞恩斯和博塔斯在内的100多名运动员支持。
APEX还持有阿尔派 F1车队的少数股份。
keyPointsEn: APEX is a sports-focused investment firm backed by more than 100 athletes, including Lando Norris, Carlos Sainz and Valtteri Bottas.
APEX also owns a minority stake in the Alpine F1 team.

items.titleZh: 小红牛在奥斯汀站后确定两个关键关注点
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中表现出色，但车队仍需关注两个关键领域。

media.altZh: 小红牛在奥斯汀站后确定两个关键关注点 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Red Bull identifies two "key focus" areas after Max Verstappen's promising start in Austin
detailZh: 小红牛在马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中表现出色后确定两个关键关注点。
维斯塔潘认为在美洲赛道的第一天“一点也不糟糕”。除了极端的颠簸外，技术总监皮埃尔·瓦切还指出了另一个对小红牛来说非常重要的领域。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中排名第二和第三。在两场练习赛中，这位四次世界冠军都落后查尔斯·勒克莱尔不到两十分，后者在两场练习赛中都设定了基准。
例如，小红牛并没有像在马来西亚那样立即从其他车队中脱颖而出，但维斯塔潘仍然对小红牛22在德克萨斯州的早期表现表示满意。
“本周末的起步很积极。这条赛道在寻找高速和低速弯角之间的最佳妥协点时从来都不容易”，荷兰人在FP2结束后说道。
“这些凹凸使得情况更加困难，因此你需要在车内找到良好的平衡并进入节奏。这就是我们在FP1和FP2之间一直在努力的事情。为了微调这个平衡，我们还有更多的工作要做，但总的来说，这并不是一个糟糕的一天。”
从实际意义上讲，这意味着车队本周末需要在两种不同的方式中找到妥协。鉴于美国赛车场的布局多样化，第一个问题关注的是高速和低速弯角之间的平衡。根据GPS数据，红牛在高速路段表现出竞争力，这使得技术总监皮埃尔·瓦赫非常明确地知道需要改进的地方。
“目前我们关注的显然是低速性能。低速对我们来说至关重要。”
这反映在数据中。比较勒克莱尔、安东内利和维斯塔潘的最快圈速，赛道的最慢弯道几乎都是红色的——换句话说，这是法拉利的领地。勒克莱尔在刹车和1号弯的出弯处都很强，在11号弯，也就是长直道前的慢速左弯，也表现出同样的模式。
在那个长直道的末端——就在刹车点之前——维斯塔潘几乎比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，而安东内利则快了超过两十分之一。然而，维斯塔潘在12号到16号弯之间损失了大量的时间，这是赛道上的另一个较慢的段落。
这强调了瓦赫的评论，尽管在奥斯汀的挑战不仅仅是找到不同类型弯道的正确平衡。同样重要的是在绝对性能和能够合理应对颠簸的赛车之间的妥协，维斯塔潘在周四的媒体日将其描述为“无法接受”和“失控”。
当被问及小红牛22如何应对赛道条件时，瓦赫说：“赛车对那些颠簸的反应就像你预期的那样，它跳得很多。”
“赛道非常颠簸，尤其是在1号弯道刹车时。你必须非常小心。但是，是的，这就是我们使用这种设置的问题所在。它没有去年那么硬，但也没有那么远[偏离那个程度]。这辆车的颠簸适应性在这里不是很好。”
使用“设置”这个术语，Wache并不是指红牛的选择，而是指当前一代的F1赛车。理论上，这些赛车在颠簸路面上应该比近年来的地面效应赛车更舒适，但维斯塔潘在周四解释说，实际情况正好相反。
得益于主动空气动力学和直线模式，赛车在直道上略微上升。这限制了滑块磨损，使车队能够在车身高度方面进一步突破极限。因此，在刹车和过弯时，车身高度保持较低，这正是美洲赛道极其颠簸的区域。
据Wache所说，改善赛车在那些颠簸上的表现和其低速性能是红牛在排位赛前的两个主要优先事项。
detailEn: Red Bull identifies two "key focus" areas after Max Verstappen's promising start in Austin

Verstappen concludes that Friday at the Circuit of the Americas was "not a bad day at all". Alongside the extreme bumps, technical director Pierre Waché pinpoints another important area for Red Bull to focus on

Max Verstappen finished Friday's practice sessions for the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in second and third place. In both sessions, the four-time world champion was less than two tenths behind Charles Leclerc, who set the benchmark on both occasions.
Red Bull is not immediately standing out from the rest of the field as it did in Malaysia, for example, but Verstappen is nevertheless largely satisfied with the early signs from the RB22 in Texas.
"It's been a positive start to the weekend. This track is never easy when it comes to finding the right compromise between the low and high-speed corners", the Dutchman said after FP2.

"The bumps make it even more difficult, so you’re trying to find a good balance in the car and get into a rhythm. That’s what we’ve been working on between FP1 and FP2. There’s still a bit more work to do to fine-tune that balance, but it wasn’t a bad day at all."

In practical terms, this means teams have to find a compromise in two different ways this weekend. Given the varied layout of the Circuit of the Americas, the first concerns the balance between high-speed and low-speed corners. Based on the GPS data, Red Bull appears competitive in the high-speed sections, making technical director Pierre Wache very clear about what needs to improve.
"It's clearly the low speed performance that we are focused on at the moment. Low speed is the key for us."

That is reflected in the data. Comparing the fastest laps of Leclerc, Antonelli and Verstappen, the slowest corners on the circuit are predominantly coloured red – in other words, Ferrari territory. Leclerc is strong both on the brakes and on the exit of Turn 1, and shows the same pattern at Turn 11, the slow left-hander before the long straight.

At the end of that long straight – just before the braking point – Verstappen is almost a tenth ahead of Leclerc's time, while Antonelli is more than two tenths ahead. However, Verstappen loses considerable ground through Turns 12 to 16, another slower section of the circuit.

This underlines Wache's comments, although the challenge in Austin is not just about finding the right balance between different types of corners. Equally important is the compromise between outright performance and a car that can cope reasonably well with the bumps, which Verstappen described as "unacceptable" and "out of control" during Thursday's media day.
"The car reacts to those bumps how you would expect, it's jumping a lot", Wache said when asked how the RB22 is dealing with the track conditions.

"The track is massively bumpy, especially at Turn 1 under braking. You have to be very careful. But yeah, that’s the problem with this type of set-up that we are using. It is not as stiff as last year, but also not so far [away from that]. The car is not very compliant on the bumps here."

By using the term set-up, Wache is not referring specifically to Red Bull's choices, but to the current generation of F1 cars. In theory, these should be slightly more comfortable over the bumps than the ground-effect cars of recent years, but Verstappen explained on Thursday that the opposite is actually the case.

Thanks to active aerodynamics and straight mode, the cars rise slightly on the straights. This limits wear on the skid blocks and gives teams the freedom to push the limits even further in terms of ride height. As a result, the ride height is low under braking and through the corners, precisely the areas where the Circuit of the Americas is extremely bumpy.
According to Wache, improving the car's behaviour over those bumps and its low-speed performance are Red Bull's two main priorities ahead of qualifying.
keyPointsZh: 车队技术总监皮埃尔·瓦切指出，除了极端的颠簸外，还有另一个重要领域需要关注
尽管小红牛没有像在马来西亚那样立即脱颖而出，但维斯塔潘对小红牛22在德克萨斯州的早期表现表示满意
keyPointsEn: Technical director Pierre Waché identifies another important area to focus on
Verstappen is largely satisfied with the early signs from the RB22 in Texas

detailZh: 安东内利称梅赛德斯在美国大奖赛取得进步，车队在逐步消化升级
随着梅赛德斯近期升级让赛车更快但也更难调校到最佳窗口，安东内利认为车队在美国大奖赛练习赛中取得了急需的进展
F1车手积分榜领跑者安东内利认为，梅赛德斯在美国大奖赛上又迈出一步，努力从近期升级套件中挖掘性能。
梅赛德斯来到奥斯汀颇具挑战性的美洲赛道，带来新的前翼选项，以进一步补充两站前在马来西亚引入的重大升级套件。那次初步升级提高了赛车的性能上限，但也让赛车更敏感、更难调校到最佳状态。
在安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔于新加坡站使用不同套件后，如今两人都用上了最新规格，梅赛德斯在奥斯汀从第一节练习到第二节练习的进展表明，W17 仍然很难进入正确的工作窗口。
但当魔法发生时，性能是可以被挖掘出来的，周五安东内利仅落后法拉利在第二节练习领跑的夏尔·勒克莱尔 0.042 秒。
“相比第一节练习，我在车里感觉更好了，”安东内利说。“还有很多工作要做，但这是很好的进步，现在我们会尝试进一步提升。两辆车使用相同套件有帮助，因为我们可以尝试很多不同的东西，也能更好地理解这套套件。”
“自新加坡以来，我们得以分析数据，更好地理解这套套件的需求。我们仍在努力寻找如何让赛车进入正确窗口，但我们一直在向前迈进，我们会看看还能做些什么来进一步提升。”
长距离试跑的初步数据显示，四支顶尖车队实力相当接近，红牛和法拉利或许略领先于梅赛德斯和迈凯伦，这为德克萨斯站的周末增添了悬念。
赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林补充道：“我们第一节练习表现不佳。我们本希望通过两辆车上的升级套件探索更宽的调校窗口，但我们在锁死方面遇到了困难，这在我们单圈工作和长距离试跑中都是很大的限制。”
“我们在进入下午的练习赛前重新调整了赛车，这似乎让我们处于更好的状态。我们的平衡问题减少了，赛车更可预测，圈速也因此有所提升。”
拉塞尔仅获得第五名，落后勒克莱尔零点七秒，因为他没能跑出一个完整的圈——他第一次使用软胎的尝试因超出赛道限制而作废，第二次则因在COTA赛道最快路段S弯中出现巨大甩尾而毁掉。
周六排位赛的故事不仅关乎赛车的极限性能，还关乎如何在严苛的最后一节中让倍耐力的软胎保持活力，因为在排位赛模拟中，随着后轮橡胶开始衰退，多位车手出现了锁死或冲出赛道的情况。
“我认为关键就是在那个连续弯路段保持后胎状态良好，这样你才能在最后一个弯角拥有性能，”车队副领队布拉德利·洛德表示。
布拉德利·洛德，梅赛德斯AMG F1车队副领队
“就是把调校做到位，让赛车能够旋转而不必过度消耗后胎、过度使用油门，如果我们能做到这一点，应该就能处于良好状态。”
理论上，奥斯汀是安东内利锁定首个世界冠军的第一次机会。但这种情况需要这位意大利车手赢得比赛，同时拉塞尔排名第九或更低，并且刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第五或更低，因此梅赛德斯并没有过度关注这一情形。
洛德指出：“归根结底，基米本周末夺冠意味着车队经历了一场非常糟糕的比赛，因为数学上要求乔治排名第九或更低，这不是我们想要的比赛方式，也不是我们追求的结果。”
“所以，机会非常渺茫，理论上有可能，但实际来说，这不是赛点周末。我们只会努力上场，尽可能多拿积分，然后看看数学上何时能对我们更有利一些。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli hails "step forward" at United States GP as Mercedes chips away at upgrades
As Mercedes' recent upgrades made its car quicker but also tougher to get in the sweet spot, Kimi Antonelli felt the squad made much needed progress in United States Grand Prix practice
Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli reckons Mercedes has made another step trying to extract performance from its recent upgrade package at the United States Grand Prix.

Mercedes arrived at Austin's challenging Circuit of the Americas with a new front wing option to further complement its significant upgrade package introduced in Malaysia two races ago. That initial upgrade raised the performance ceiling of the car, but also made it more peaky and harder to optimise.

With both Antonelli and George Russell now on the latest specification after splitting packages in Singapore, Mercedes' progress from first to second practice in Austin suggested the W17 is still difficult to get in the right operating window.
But when the magic happens there is performance to be found, with Antonelli just 0.042s behind Ferrari's FP2 leader Charles Leclerc on Friday.

"I felt better in the car compared to FP1," Antonelli said. "There is still lots of work to do, but it was a good step forward and now we'll try to improve even further. Having both cars on the same package helps, because we can try lots of different stuff and we can have a better understanding of this package.

"Since Singapore we were able to analyse the data and understand better what this package needs. We're still trying to find how to put the car in the right window, but we've been taking steps forward and we'll see what we can do to improve even more."

Initial reads from the long runs suggested all four top teams are fairly evenly matched, with perhaps Red Bull and Ferrari slightly ahead of Mercedes and McLaren, setting up an intriguing weekend in Texas.

Trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin added: "We didn’t have a good first session. We were looking to explore a wider set-up window with the update package on both cars, but we were struggling with locking, which was a big limitation in both our single-lap work and the long runs.

"We repositioned the cars going into the afternoon session and that seems to have put us in a better place. We had fewer balance issues, the car was more predictable, and the lap times improved as a result."

Russell only managed fifth, seven tenths behind Leclerc, after not getting a proper lap in - his first soft tyre effort scratched for exceeding track limits and his second ruined by a huge snap through the fastest portion of COTA's Esses.

The story of Saturday qualifying will not just be about ultimate car performance, but also about keeping Pirelli's soft tyres alive through the demanding final sector, with several drivers locking up or going off the track as the rear rubber started fading in qualifying simulations.
"I think it's just all about keeping the rear tyres in good shape through that twisty bit so that you've got the performance in the last corner," said deputy team principal Bradley Lord.
Bradley Lord, Deputy Team Principal, Mercedes AMG F1 Team

"It's just getting the set-up in the right place and getting the car able to rotate without needing to overuse the rear tyres, overuse the throttle and if we can do that then we should be in good shape."

Austin is theoretically the first opportunity for Antonelli to seal his maiden world championship. But as that would involve the Italian winning the race with Russell finishing ninth or lower - and Lewis Hamilton finishing fifth or lower - it's not a scenario Mercedes is overly preoccupied with.

"Ultimately, for Kimi to win this weekend it means the team's had a really bad race, because the maths say George needs to be ninth or below, and that isn't how we want to go racing and the result we're aiming for," Lord pointed out.

"So, it's a very minimal chance, it's theoretically possible, but in practical terms, this isn't the match point weekend. We'll just try and get out there, get as many points as possible and then see when the maths start to come towards us a little bit more."
